description: This file defines a controller class 'Language' within the Opencart Admin module, handling events related to language management, such as adding tasks, dumping language variables into templates, and backing up/restoring language data around controller execution.

classes.name: Language
classes.description: Controller class for handling language-related events in the admin area, such as task scheduling and language data backup/restoration.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Adds a task to generate the language list; triggered after language add/edit/delete operations.

methods.name: template
methods.description: Populates the provided arguments with all current language variables, preparing variables for template rendering.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Stores current language data into a backup before a controller executes.

methods.name: after
methods.description: Restores language data from backup after a controller has executed.
